features.name: Show Details in Lookup Dialogues
features.description: New show details action added to all simple lookup dialogues allowing users to navigate to record details. Works with both mouse and keyboard via the new Control Alt down shortcut.
caveats: Control Alt down keyboard shortcut navigates to card pages or list if card page not available
No uptake required for partners - built into existing and new code

features.name: Control Alt Down Keyboard Shortcut
features.description: New keyboard shortcut that navigates users directly to related data card pages. Works on both simple and advanced lookups, taking user directly to card rather than non-editable list.
caveats: If no card page exists, navigates to list and filters the selected record

features.name: Company Data Search via Tell Me
features.description: Users can now search across company data relevant to their role using the Alt Q keyboard shortcut with Tell Me. The focused value on an editable page is automatically copied to Tell Me for searching.
caveats: Tell Me is also available on Business Central mobile app but separate session covers more details
Search results are optimized and tailored to permissions and user role

features.name: Smart Search Results Page
features.description: Enhanced Tell Me search results page that intelligently opens records in their proper context. For example, finding a purchase order line opens the purchase order page rather than just the line.

features.name: Explore Reports Link
features.description: New link in Tell Me and Role Center homepage labeled explore reports or all reports that provides an overview of all available reports organized by department or role, adapted from role explorer.
caveats: Based on links from role center homepages to report objects

features.name: Improved Link Sharing with Readable Naming
features.description: Business Central web client now uses a consistent and readable naming scheme for shared links to records. Links display clean, human-readable format with just enough context to understand what record they reference.
caveats: Plain text fields and applications like Windows Notepad still display raw URL

features.name: Legacy List Views Deprecation Timeline
features.description: Legacy list views will be deprecated and removed from the web client by Update 24, approximately April 2024. Users must migrate legacy list views to the newer model.
caveats: Community given more time to migrate

features.name: Automatic Field Value Saving
features.description: Web client will automatically save field values when clicking or tabbing out of a field. This change will be automatically enabled for everyone in Update 24, approximately April 2024.
caveats: Rollout date extended to Update 24, approximately April 2024

features.name: Rich Content Fields
features.description: Developers can now implement rich content fields natively in AL code without control add-ins. Fields stretch to fill horizontal space, are multi-line with maximum height, and include toolbar with over 25 functions and keyboard shortcuts for formatting, pictures, tables, and pasting content.
caveats: Use cases include product information management, rich annotation of records, social media content authoring

features.name: Actionable Error Messages
features.description: Error message dialogues now include actions to help users quickly resolve issues and get guidance on correction. Available since 2023 release Wave 1 July update, with capabilities for checking documents and journals while working.
caveats: Includes checking documents and journals for errors
Supports bulk application of recommendations via accept recommended action

features.name: Collectible Errors and Check Documents Capability
features.description: Allows users to collect errors and check documents and journals while working, producing interruptions and giving an overview of posting errors.

features.name: Dimension Posting Error Fixes
features.description: Users can now fix dimension code related errors with recommended actions, specifically for dimension posting rules requiring dimension to be the same or blank.
caveats: Only applies to dimension code related errors in first iteration

features.name: Custom Error Fixes Interface for AL Developers
features.description: Interface provided for AL developers to add custom fixes for custom errors to achieve parity with actionable error dialogues.

features.name: Inline Validation Dialogue Improvements
features.description: Inline validation dialogues now surface errors during data entry with navigate and fix it actions that either take you to the problem or have Business Central fix it when possible.

features.name: Refresh and Copy Details Actions in Validation Messages
features.description: Inline validation dialogues now include refresh and copy details actions positioned closer to the error, allowing users to copy and share error details conveniently.

features.name: Tab Naming for Context and Multi-Window Work
features.description: Consistent naming convention applied to browser tab titles showing context of what is inside each tab, with company badges when configured. Makes tabs more readable and easier to identify at a glance.
caveats: Company badge appears only if configured in setup

features.name: Company Switcher Feature with New Tab Option
features.description: Allows users to open the same page in another company in a new tab with a click, enabling easy comparison of data across companies.

features.name: Page Inspection Auto-Scroll to Field Feature
features.description: Clicking or activating a field in the page inspection pane now automatically scrolls that field into view on the page canvas, making it easy to locate fields for editing or modification.

features.name: Page Inspection Link to Visual Studio Code
features.description: New link in the page inspection pane allows users to explore the page in Visual Studio Code. Field menu items also provide direct links to code for specific fields.

features.name: Page Inspector Field Search
features.description: Page inspector now has a handy feature to help users get straight to fields on complex pages quickly without needing to manually search through all page elements.

features.name: Adding Source Table Fields to Pages
features.description: New capability to add existing table fields to pages for optimization and layout adjustment. These fields are read-only but allow bringing source table data to the page. Available with update 23.

features.name: Make Fields Read-Only
features.description: Users can now make any editable field read-only by locking its editability. This helps clean up pages visually and prevents data entry accidents by protecting certain fields from modification.

features.name: Analysis Tabs
features.description: Analysis tabs provide a new way to derive insights from data without switching apps or requiring development. Introduced in preview last wave, now generally available with improvements including shareability, access control, and support for queries.
features.status_evidence_quote: without the need for development in wave two this is now generally available for all of our customers

features.name: Analysis Tab Sharing with Hyperlinks
features.description: Users can now share links to analysis tabs with coworkers, with the analysis tab name included in the hyperlink for easy reference and access.

features.name: Mobile Barcode Scanning
features.description: Mobile apps now support barcode scanning to enable users to be more productive while using Business Central on mobile devices.
